description: One signed step in a game. Every move names the root and the mover's previous move in this game by strongRef; a player's move also names their sheet. Nothing is edited: retcons, revisions, retirements and handovers are moves.

sheet.description: Required on player moves. The first move naming a sheet pins its cid.

prev.description: The mover's previous move in this game. Absent only on the mover's first move.

kind.description: prompt and retcon and handover: GM only. ask: a roll request inside a prompt; its cid is the dice key. strike: GM only, removes one named ability from a sheet (sheet + abilityName); the player may revise or buy another.

prompt.description: On an ask: the GM prompt move it answers. One ask per sheet per prompt; first indexed counts.

action.description: On an ask: which action's dots form the pool.

bonus.description: On an ask: dice added or removed (assist, push, devil's bargain).

target.description: On retcon: the move it voids. On handover: the new game root.

ability.description: On an advance that buys an ability: the ability, in the same shape as on a sheet.

abilityName.description: On a strike: the name of the ability struck.

track.description: A track named in the root's rules, or 'action:<name>' on an advance.
